ahooks useDebounce (debounced value).description:
Debounce a changing value. This hook debounces a value, unlike the react-use hook of the same name which debounces an effect. Requires useDebounce from ahooks.

防抖一个变化中的值；该 Hook 防抖的是值，与 react-use 同名 Hook 防抖副作用不同。需要从 ahooks 导入 useDebounce。

ahooks useDebounceFn.description:
Create a debounced function while keeping the latest closure. Requires useDebounceFn from ahooks.

创建保持最新闭包的防抖函数；需要从 ahooks 导入 useDebounceFn。

ahooks useThrottle (throttled value).description:
Throttle a changing value. Requires useThrottle from ahooks.

节流一个变化中的值；需要从 ahooks 导入 useThrottle。

ahooks useThrottleFn.description:
Create a throttled runner while keeping the latest closure. This returns a runner, unlike the react-use hook of the same name which returns the throttled result. Requires useThrottleFn from ahooks.

创建保持最新闭包的节流运行器；它返回运行器，与 react-use 同名 Hook 返回节流后的结果不同。需要从 ahooks 导入 useThrottleFn。

ahooks useBoolean.description:
Manage a boolean value with stable actions. This hook returns a tuple, unlike the usehooks-ts hook of the same name which returns an object. Requires useBoolean from ahooks.

使用稳定操作管理布尔值；该 Hook 返回数组，与 usehooks-ts 同名 Hook 返回对象不同。需要从 ahooks 导入 useBoolean。

ahooks useLocalStorageState.description:
Persist React state to localStorage. Requires useLocalStorageState from ahooks and a browser environment.

将 React 状态持久化到 localStorage；需要从 ahooks 导入 useLocalStorageState，并运行在浏览器环境。

ahooks useClickAway.description:
Run a callback for clicks outside a target ref or element. The callback comes first here, the reverse of the react-use hook with the same name. Requires useClickAway from ahooks and a target ref.

点击目标 ref 或元素之外时执行回调；此处回调在前，与 react-use 同名 Hook 的参数顺序相反。需要从 ahooks 导入 useClickAway 和目标 ref。

ahooks useEventListener.description:
Subscribe to a DOM event with automatic cleanup; the target goes in the options object. Requires useEventListener from ahooks and a browser target.

订阅 DOM 事件并自动清理，目标写在 options 对象里；需要从 ahooks 导入 useEventListener 和浏览器目标。

ahooks useMemoizedFn.description:
Create a stable callback identity that still reads current state. Requires useMemoizedFn from ahooks.

创建引用稳定、且仍能读取当前状态的回调；需要从 ahooks 导入 useMemoizedFn。

body: const [${1:count}, { inc, dec, reset }] = useCounter(${2:0}, { min: ${3:0} });
ahooks useCounter.description:
Manage a numeric counter with optional bounds. Requires useCounter from ahooks.

管理带可选上下界的数值计数器；需要从 ahooks 导入 useCounter。

ahooks useInterval.description:
Run a callback on an interval; pass undefined as the delay to pause it. Requires useInterval from ahooks.

按间隔执行回调，delay 传 undefined 可暂停；需要从 ahooks 导入 useInterval。
